title: Normative ref to JMAP-FILENODE is incomplete and may not exist
description: The JMAP-FILENODE normative reference has no author, date, or seriesinfo — only a tracker URL. If draft-ietf-jmap-filenode does not exist or is not stable, this entire spec is unimplementable. Either pin a specific version with seriesinfo, or explicitly acknowledge this spec depends on JMAP-FILENODE being published first.
close_reason: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 confirmed active WG document; pinned version and named author
